summary: Join our financial analysis, planning, and control training course to develop critical skills for effective financial management.
lede: Financial analysis, planning and control uses accounting information to assess performance and support budgeting, investment choices and financial oversight. This course is for finance professionals, budget managers and internal auditors who need to turn financial data into practical plans and controls. It covers financial ratios, rolling forecasts, variance analysis, investment appraisal and internal controls, with practice in building budgets, evaluating projects and reporting results.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for the fiscal health and strategic direction of their organizations.
modules: Financial Statement Analysis and Performance Evaluation
Strategic Planning and Modern Budgeting Frameworks
Internal Control and Financial Risk Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of basic accounting principles (debits/credits) and experience using Microsoft Excel for basic calculations. No prior experience in advanced financial modeling is required.
